description: Use when you need a weather forecast for a latitude/longitude anywhere in the world: hourly temperature, wind speed and direction, humidity, pressure, cloud cover. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /weather, $0.001 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Forecast and US alerts for one point; for earthquakes and open natural events near a site use hazards_near. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

hours.description: forecast horizon in hours, 1..240 (default 48); steps are hourly first, then 6-hourly as MET publishes

name: weather
title: Weather
